brief.title: Check a file before opening it in Python
brief.question: How do I check whether a path points to a file?
brief.notes: Provided editorial example checked against the linked Python documentation on 2026-11-01. Not a live Gemini script.

sources.title: Python pathlib documentation
sources.excerpt: Path.exists checks whether a path exists. Path.is_file checks whether the path points to a regular file.

claims.text: Path.is_file checks whether a path points to a regular file.
